tools.name: search_edit_hotels
tools.description: Search the hotels in The Edit by Chase Travel (the Chase Sapphire Reserve luxury hotel collection) with their typical Chase Travel nightly rate and whether they take the 2026 double credit. Returns at most 20 per page and 5 pages.

tools.name: get_edit_hotel
tools.description: Details for one Edit hotel by its Chase hotel ID (from search_edit_hotels): typical rate, month-by-month median rates, cheapest months, lowest night in the calendar, double-credit status, Edit benefits and dining-credit restaurants within 3 km.

tools.name: edit_city_months
tools.description: Month-by-month median Chase Travel nightly rates across a city's Edit hotels, with its cheapest and priciest months.

tools.name: find_dining_credit_restaurants
tools.description: Sapphire Reserve Exclusive Tables restaurants (where the $300 a year dining credit works) by city, or nearest to a point.

tools.name: sapphire_reserve_credits
tools.description: The Chase Sapphire Reserve's credits: value, how each works, and whether it needs activation, with links to the guides.
